questions.question:
A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only one person sits between A and L when counted from the left of L. K sits third to the right of J. C sits third to the left of B. K sits to the immediate right of C. D is not an immediate neighbour of C.

How many people sit between D and L when counted from the right of D?
questions.solution:
• A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.
 
• Only one person sits between A and L when counted from the left of L.
 
• K sits third to the right of J.
 
• C sits third to the left of B.
 
• K sits to the immediate right of C.
 
• D is not an immediate neighbour of C

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d5e30955d4032aa47d800bbc30785ba83dab39403ba44de77edd6f93f6e2937.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

38 + 8 × 2 - __**16 ÷ 8**__ = ?

38 +__** 8 × 2**__ - 2 = ?

38 + 16 - 2 = ?

54 - 2 = ?

52.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question: Karan ranks 27th from the top and 16th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.solution:
__Given__:

Karan position from the top: 27th.

Karan position from the bottom: 16th.

__Formula used__:

The total number of people = Position of the person from Top + Position of the person from Bottom - 1.

Therefore,

The total number of students = 27 + 16 - 1 = 42.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
